action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality but a near-white-noise spectrum, making individual model rankings unstable (Kendall tau 0.041) and error correlations high (mean 0.855, only 5 independent groups). A trimmed mean over the 7 most consistently-ranked models is a robust combination that avoids overfitting to three noisy validation windows while still benefiting from the small spread among the top models. The leader is a seed baseline and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable, so no further strategy is likely to produce a real gain.
